label: Oracle Check
description: Script-authority oracle validation node. Has two input tiers: artifact_in (non-authority, accepts model proposals for checking) and validated_artifact (authority, forbids proposals — only pre-disposed artifacts may enter). Emits oracle_output (untagged) representing the gate verdict. Models must route their proposal through artifact_in, never directly to validated_artifact.

inputs.name: artifact_in
inputs.description: Non-authority input. Receives the artifact (possibly model-proposed) for oracle checking. No tag constraint — proposals may enter here for evaluation.

inputs.name: validated_artifact
inputs.description: Authority input. Receives a pre-validated, non-proposal artifact that has already passed script disposition. Forbids proposal-tagged values — a model output must never wire here directly.

outputs.name: oracle_output
outputs.description: Oracle verdict record (gate_green or gate_red). Untagged — this is a script-authority output, not a model proposal.

outputs.name: passed
outputs.description: True if the oracle gate passed (MechanicalGreen path).
